summary.en: The same picture jumps to tighter crops of itself on the beat, hard cuts with no tween, and holds on the subject.
summary.zh: 同一画面逐拍硬切到更紧的裁切，没有补间，最后停在主体上。

fits: Pointing at one thing inside a busy screen, on the beat; a highlight moment (flash).
notFor: Two different pictures (that is a cut, not a crop); slow, quiet passages.

intent.en: "Look here, closer, this one": hard cuts to ever tighter crops force the eye onto one thing; with flashes it becomes the film's loudest drumbeat.
intent.zh: “看这里、再近点、就是它”：一刀比一刀紧的硬切逼着观众盯住一个东西；加白闪时就是全片最响的一记鼓点。

content.en: Wraps one still picture (a screenshot or a scene) and the subject's rect inside it; 2–3 crops; the picture must stay sharp at about 2.6×.
content.zh: 包住一张静止画面（截图或一场），给出主体在画里的位置；2–3 级裁切；素材放大约 2.6 倍仍要清楚。

fits.zh: 在繁杂的画面里踩拍点名一个东西；高光时刻（flash 连闪定格）。

notFor.zh: 两张不同的画面（那是切，不是裁）；慢、安静的段落；从不硬切的 morph、thread 类风格。

pairs.note: marks the subject once the last crop holds

en: All crops share the subject's centre; reframing each step makes three shots, not a jump cut.
Put every cut on a beat with a click or shutter sound; silent, it reads as the picture glitching.
Once per film with flash, and hold long after the last cut; a cross-fade of even 2 frames kills the hard cut.
zh: 各级裁切钉同一个主体中心；每级重新构图就成了三个镜头，不是跳切。
每刀落在拍点上并配一声咔嚓或快门；无声时像画面乱跳。
flash 版一支片最多一次，切完要留足停顿；哪怕加 2 帧交叉淡化，硬切感就没了。

upstream.name: 跳切递进推近
upstream.summary: 打断节奏——jump-cut-punch-in 三级跳切推近：同构图三次无补间硬跳放大，逐级逼近目标
upstream.use: 用"打断连续性"本身当节奏器：顿挫推近（A）；与 beat-cut-moves（切点排布）互补

upstream.name: 连闪定格
upstream.summary: 硬切当节拍乐器——连闪定格：三次白闪各硬切同一画面的一个裁切（全景→卡片→特写），快门余韵沉降后停在特写收束
upstream.use: 高光段落把"切"本身打成鼓点；颁奖连拍式的仪式感、关键信息的加冕
